diagnosis: The clone_template action fetches source_template using get_object_or_404(WorkflowTemplate, pk=pk) rather than self.get_object() or scoping by tenant. Any authenticated tenant user can clone and copy proprietary workflow automation definitions belonging to other enterprise tenants.
